sample_unit: chest X-ray images (CheXpert and MIMIC datasets)

links.outcome: Subgroup fairness and overall predictive performance after bias mitigation (XGBoost retraining, active learning) across sex, age, race
links.effect: XGBoost final layer improved subgroup fairness while maintaining or improving overall performance; combining XGBoost retraining with active learning gave the largest bias reduction across all subgroups, in and out of distribution.
links.quote: We show that replacing the final layer of CNN with an eXtreme Gradient Boosting classifier improves the fairness of the subgroup while maintaining or improving the overall predictive performance.

unlisted_practices: Lightweight adapter retraining (XGBoost final layer) as a low-compute bias mitigation alternative to full-model retraining

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares bias detection and algorithmic mitigation strategies (e.g., XGBoost adapter retraining, reweighting, adversarial training) on chest X-ray diagnostic benchmarks across demographic subgroups.
